text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site. Must-haves, each one will be checked: today's opening hours are highlighted automatically; the pre-order form shows a running total in rupees; the loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles with the 10th marked FREE; every menu item shows a price; the location section has a "Get directions" link; the page works at 360px wide.

@Requester The brief gives six checks but not the content they depend on. I need opening hours, the menu with prices, the address and the pre-order details before I can write a checkable charter.
1. What are the opening hours for each day of the week (including any closed days)?
2. List the menu items with prices in rupees, grouped as you want them shown (for example Coffee, Tea, Food). Which of these can be pre-ordered?
3. What is the exact address in Indiranagar, and should "Get directions" open a Google Maps link? If you have the link, please share it.
   Option 1: Google Maps link
   Option 2: Apple Maps link
   Option 3: Address only, build the link from it
4. What should the pre-order form collect and do on submit? For example name, phone, pickup time, then show a confirmation on the page. Also, what does the 10th FREE stamp give (for example a free drink)?
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

1. Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm. No closed days.

2. Menu (prices in ₹):
Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220
Cold: Cold brew 200
Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130
All items can be pre-ordered.

3. Address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.
Option 1: https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038

4. The form collects name, phone, items with quantities, and pickup time (within opening hours). It shows a running total in rupees. On submit it sends the order to WhatsApp +91 98450 00000 and shows a confirmation on the page. Pay at pickup.
The 10th stamp gives one free drink of any size.
